signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - Own core product areas and be accountable for outcomes, from ideation and strategy to execution and launch.
Engage directly with customers - Run user interviews, workflow mapping, usability testing, shadowing, competitive research, and data analysis. Work with Customer Success and Sales…
Drive high-velocity execution with engineering and design - Translate strategy into intuitive experiences that are built to scale. Help engineers and designers understand users…
Define what success looks like - Set success metrics before you build, make sure the right things get instrumented, and review outcomes after launch.
Land the launch - Craft messaging that resonates with users, enable Sales and Marketing to win with customers, and drive cross-functional readiness across teams.
